sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Disable analytics
Stops AppsFlyer from tracking installs and in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions. Tuya's own usage statistics are left on.
GmsCore support
Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Hide ads
Removes the Google ad banners and ad rows the app shows, such as the one above the Me menu.
Hide AI ask bar
Removes the "How can I help?" Tuya AI bar above the navigation bar and at the bottom of device panels.
Hide Explore tab
Removes the Explore tab from the navigation bar.
Hide My Orders
Removes the "My Orders" row from the Me tab.
Hide Plus button
Removes the "Plus" pill from the home header.
Hide Recommended for you
Removes the "Recommended for You" section and its cards (AI Notes and the rest) from the home screen.
Hide Rewards Hub
Removes the "Rewards Hub" row and its banner from the Me tab.
Hide Tuya AI Web Version
Removes the "Tuya AI Web Version" row from the Me tab.
Spoof signature
Lets the patched app start. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the app's integrity check rejects, so without this it closes a few seconds after it opens.

sources.label: Dutch App
sources.author: Dutch App
patch_list: Allow any Android Auto host

Lets any Android Auto compatible host connect to Tuya Smart Life's car screens, including DriveDeck, Gearslip, MyCar, Flywheel, BetterAuto, AndroidAuto and AARE, whatever its package name or signing key. Google's Android Auto keeps working.
